name: Glory is to Allah
description: A thousand Hasanah will be written for you, or a thousand sins will be wiped away

name: Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him.
description: Will have his sins forgiven even if they are like the foam of the sea.will not be surpassed on the Day of Resurrection by anyone with better deeds than one who utters the same words or utters more of these words.

name: Glorified is Allah, and The praise is for Allah
description: fill that which is between heaven and earth

name: Glorified is Allah the Most Great and praised is He.
description: will have a date palm planted for him in Paradise.

name: Glorified is Allah and praised is He, Glorified is Allah the Most Great.
description: Two words are light on the tongue, weigh heavily in the balance, and are loved by the Most Merciful One

name: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah Alone, Who has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is Able to do all things.
description: he will have a reward equivalent to that for emancipating ten slaves, a hundred good deeds will be recorded to his credit, hundred of his sins will be blotted out from his scroll, and he will be safeguarded against the devil on that day till the evening

name: There is no power and no might except by Allah.
description: a treasure from the treasures of Paradise

name: Praise be to God the Lord of the universe
description: It fills the servant’s balance with good deeds.

name: O Allah, exalt the mention of Muhammad
description: Whoever prays for Allah's blessings upon me, In the morning and in the evening, my intercession will reach him on the Day of Resurrection.

name: I seek the forgiveness of Allah
description: The prophet used to do it

name: Glorified is Allah, and The praise is for Allah, and There is none worthy of worship but Allah, and Allah is the Most Great,
description: أنهن أحب الكلام الى الله، ومكفرات للذنوب، وغرس الجنة، وجنة لقائلهن من النار، وأحب الى النبي عليه السلام مما طلعت عليه الشمس، والباقيات الصالحات.

name: There is none worthy of worship but Allah!
description: The most excellent words of remembrance are: There is none worthy of worship but Allah.

name: Allah is the Most Great
description: Whoever says Allah is the Most Great, twenty good deeds are recorded for him and twenty bad deeds are removed from him

name: Glory be to Allah, praise be to Allah, There's no God but Allah, Allah is the greatest, O Allah forgive me, have mercy on me and provide for me
description: you have been given the good of this world and the Next.

name: All praise is to Allah, praise in abundance, good and blessed.
description:
The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ); said: 
I saw twelve angels racing against one another to be the one to take them to Allah.

name: Allah is truly Great, praise be to Allah in abundance. Glory be to Allah in the morning and the evening.
description: He (the Holy Prophet) said: It (its utterance) surprised me, for the doors of heaven were opened for It.

name: O Allah, bestow Your favor on Muhammad and on the family of Muhammad as You have bestowed Your favor on Ibrahim and on the family of Ibrahim, You are Praiseworthy, Most Glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad as You have blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim, You are Praiseworthy, Most Glorious.
description: Every time, ten sins are removed from him, he is raised ten degrees, God blesses him ten times, and they are presented to the Messenger, may God bless him and grant him peace (any number).
